title: Chief AI Officer Learning Path

modules.title: The CAIO Mandate
modules.subtitle: From technology leader to enterprise AI executive
modules.summary: Define the CAIO role, its decision rights, its relationship to the CEO/CIO/CTO/CDO/CISO, and the operating outcomes the role is accountable for.

modules.title: AI & GenAI Technical Fluency
modules.subtitle: Know enough to make architecture and investment decisions
modules.summary: Build executive-level fluency in modern ML, transformers, foundation models, embeddings, RAG, fine-tuning, agents, evaluation, inference, and model economics.

modules.title: AI Evaluation & Assurance
modules.subtitle: Measure quality, safety, reliability, and business readiness
modules.summary: Build an enterprise evaluation discipline for models, RAG systems, agents, and AI-enabled workflows. Learn how to translate business expectations into testable criteria, combine automated and human grading, validate agent behavior end to end, and connect pre-launch evals to production monitoring.

lessons.title: Evaluation as an executive control system

modules.title: AI Strategy & Portfolio
modules.subtitle: Turn business strategy into a value-ranked AI portfolio
modules.summary: Build an enterprise AI strategy, find high-value use cases, sequence bets, and distinguish transformative initiatives from automation theater.

modules.title: Data, Platform & Architecture
modules.subtitle: Design the foundation that lets AI scale safely
modules.summary: Understand AI-ready data, model/platform architecture, integration patterns, cloud choices, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.

modules.title: Governance, Risk & Regulation
modules.subtitle: Move fast without creating unmanaged enterprise exposure
modules.summary: Operationalize AI governance using risk tiers, lifecycle controls, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OECD principles, privacy/security practices, and current regulation.

lessons.title: EU AI Act and regulatory scanning

modules.title: Security, Privacy & Resilience
modules.subtitle: Secure models, data, prompts, tools, and autonomous actions
modules.summary: Develop executive command of AI-specific security threats and controls, including prompt injection, data leakage, model supply chain risk, excessive agency, and secure deployment patterns.

modules.title: AI Economics & Investment
modules.subtitle: Make AI a disciplined capital-allocation problem
modules.summary: Build business cases, unit economics, benefit-realization models, portfolio funding approaches, and vendor economics for AI investments.

lessons.title: From pilot metrics to enterprise value

modules.title: Operating Model, Talent & Change
modules.subtitle: Rewire how the company works, not just what technology it buys
modules.summary: Design the AI organization, federated delivery model, skills strategy, workforce transformation, adoption system, and responsible incentives needed for sustained change.

modules.title: Executive & Board Leadership
modules.subtitle: Communicate AI as strategy, risk, capital, and organizational change
modules.summary: Learn to communicate with CEOs and boards using business language, decision memos, scenario planning, governance reporting, and concise executive narratives.

modules.title: CAIO Capstone
modules.subtitle: Produce evidence that you can do the job
modules.summary: Integrate the course into an interview- and board-ready Chief AI Officer portfolio that demonstrates strategy, architecture, governance, economics, operating model, and executive leadership.

dashboard.eyebrow: FROM TECHNICAL LEADER TO ENTERPRISE AI EXECUTIVE
dashboard.headline: Learn to lead AI across the whole company.
dashboard.intro: A 26-week course for experienced technical leaders. Read original lessons, work through decisions and examples, then build a portfolio you can defend with executives.
dashboard.learningDesign: Each module uses explicit objectives, short conceptual lessons, active application, retrieval practice, cumulative artifacts, and a capstone. Revisit completed lessons on a spaced schedule: 1 week, 1 month, and 3 months.
dashboard.learningRhythm: Recommended rhythm: learn → apply → quiz → explain aloud → revisit.
dashboard.careerOutcome: By completion, you should have an interview-ready CAIO evidence portfolio: AI charter, prioritized use-case portfolio, reference architecture, governance playbook, threat model, financial model, operating model, board update, and full enterprise AI transformation capstone.

practicePrompt: Write a short decision or artifact based on the example. State the owner, the evidence you would collect, and the condition that would change your decision. Keep it for the module homework.
reviewSuggestion: Review suggestion: return to this section after 7 days and explain the core ideas without notes before rereading.
